before.description_1: GS Privechauffeur needed a private driver website that feels professional, clear and trustworthy from the first visit. Visitors had to understand the service, when to use it and how to request more information without unnecessary friction.
before.description_2: I created a page structure with concise service information, clear benefits and visible contact options. The final WordPress page presents the private driver service in a calm and reliable way, making it easier for visitors to compare and enquire.

after.description_1: GS Privéchauffeur offers private chauffeur, airport transport, BOB rides, vehicle transport and valet services. The website needed to make those different travel situations understandable quickly while keeping comfort, reliability and booking central.
after.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around the booking journey and the main service types. Visitors can move from choosing a chauffeur service into trip details, vehicle choice and reservation, while service information, pricing context and trust signals stay close to the decision.

before.description_1: Businesssuites had useful office-rental information, but the message needed a calmer structure and clearer priority. Visitors needed to scan the page, understand the practical value, and see a simple route forward. The content also had to sound specific instead of broad or interchangeable. It made the next step clearer sooner.
before.description_2: I rewrote the content and organised the page so each section answers a clear visitor question. The result explains the office-rental work in plain English, connects benefits to real decisions, and keeps contact options close. This makes the case easier to read, compare, and trust. It made choices easier too.

after.description_1: Businesssuites rents flexible workspaces across multiple locations, including private offices, coworking and meeting rooms with different sizes, facilities and rental terms. The website needed to make those differences easy to compare before a visitor books or enquires.
after.description_2: I structured the WordPress site around locations and workspace types, with practical details such as size, pricing and facilities kept close to each option. Clear booking and enquiry routes help visitors move from comparing spaces to arranging a suitable workplace without unnecessary steps.

before.description_1: Ibtraject needed a website that answers practical visitor questions faster. The engineering offer had to be explained with clear context, useful detail and a visible route to contact. Without a tighter structure, the page risked feeling generic and harder to judge on smaller screens.
before.description_2: I refined the page by reducing repetition, improving the order of information and making each section easier to scan. The WordPress build presents the engineering offer with practical context and a steady flow, giving visitors clearer reasons to compare the work and start a conversation.

after.description_1: Ingenieursbureau Traject provides civil-engineering services including design, contracts, SSK cost estimates, project supervision, citizen participation and cable-and-pipe coordination. The website needed to explain that broad technical offer while using real projects to show how the expertise is applied.
after.description_2: I organised the WordPress content around the main civil-engineering disciplines and connected them with project examples and advice routes. Visitors can move from a specific technical need into the relevant service, see supporting project evidence and then contact the team with enough context to discuss the assignment.

before.description_1: The politics page for Monitorpolitiekeontwikkeling needed to remove hesitation before inquiry. Visitors were likely comparing providers, so the page had to explain the work quickly, show relevant details, and keep the next step obvious. Long, general wording would have made the offer feel less certain. It made choices easier too.
before.description_2: I created a more direct page flow with concise headings, specific project wording, and WordPress content fields that stay easy to maintain. The design gives Monitorpolitiekeontwikkeling a clearer presentation, while visitors can scan the work, understand the value, and move toward contact without confusion. It supported faster decisions before contact.

after.description_1: Monitor Politieke Ontwikkeling is a content-heavy nonprofit platform built around policy positions, research, reports, activities and press updates. The website needed to keep long-form information and downloadable publications accessible without making the organisation’s broader mission difficult to understand.
after.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around research, reports, activities and organisational information, with clear routes to publications, support and contact. The responsive hierarchy keeps long-form political and policy content readable while making the most important documents and next steps easier to find.

before.description_1: Kroessvisser needed a finance page that removes hesitation before inquiry. Visitors were likely comparing providers, so the page had to explain the offer quickly, show relevant details and keep the next step clear. Long or general wording would have made the service feel less certain.
before.description_2: I created a more direct page flow with concise headings, specific project wording and WordPress content fields that remain easy to maintain. The design gives Kroessvisser a clearer presentation, while visitors can scan the offer, understand the value and move towards contact without confusion.

after.description_1: Kroess & Visser brings bookkeeping, financial administration, payroll, tax support and business advice together in one finance-focused website. The challenge was to separate those services clearly while giving entrepreneurs enough trust and context before they start an advice conversation.
after.description_2: I organised the WordPress content into distinct finance and advisory routes, supported by practical explanations and trust content. Visitors can identify the service that fits their situation and move toward contact without having to interpret a broad list of accounting terms first.

before.description_1: The need for an improved webshop was required for Superfruitmand as the visitors were unable to comprehend what Superfruitmand had to offer or what was in it for them. With more details regarding the projects being shown, there would be a better understanding of how Superfruitmand could be of use.
before.description_2: I refined Superfruitmand with better WordPress architecture, more precise English writing, and a design that takes users from information to action without any distractions, along with enhanced project context for visitors evaluating the project prior to contacting them, superior structure, clear wording, and concise writing.

after.description_1: Superfruitmand is a WooCommerce webshop for fruit boxes, fruit baskets and gifts. The website needed to keep product discovery and ordering simple while still showing category choice, pricing, product details and options such as adding a personal card.
after.description_2: I structured the webshop around clear product categories and direct product pages with visible price and order controls. Business information, account access and cart actions stay available throughout the journey, so visitors can move from browsing fruit products to checkout without losing context.

before.description_1: A progress that was needed in terms of the page content included making it more understandable and convenient for comparing options offered. The page needed to provide information on the recruitment process in an easily understandable manner, which at the same time would give a sufficient amount of information about the service and encourage contact.
before.description_2: I structured the page based on the priority information that the visitors should have: the offer, the advantage, and what to do next. Concise sections, clearer writing style, and efficient WordPress distribution have facilitated the evaluation of the recruiting project. The page became more concrete, practical, and inquiry-friendly.

after.description_1: Progress serves both professionals looking for vacancies and employers looking for staff across sectors such as technology, telecom, energy, finance, customer service and government. The website needed to separate those two journeys while still presenting one clear recruitment brand.
after.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around vacancy discovery for candidates and staffing services for employers. Sector expertise, client proof and reviews support both routes, while applications and employer enquiries remain separate enough that each audience can move directly toward its own next step.

before.description_1: For the PRO Metaal recycling website, it was important to eliminate any uncertainty prior to an inquiry. The visitor was probably looking at various options, hence it was crucial that the work involved be stated clearly and the next step be made evident. Uncertainty would definitely have been reduced by concise and specific language used.
before.description_2: I streamlined the page structure using succinct headings, precise terminology, and content fields from WordPress that would always be simple to update. This helped to give PRO Metaal a more professional image, while allowing users to easily view their portfolio, comprehend the benefits of their services, and then get in touch with them.

after.description_1: PRO Metaal presents a metal-recycling business built around materials, processing and circular reuse. The website needed to explain services for metals such as aluminium, copper, old iron and electronics while keeping sustainability and the practical business enquiry visible.
after.description_2: I organised the WordPress content around recyclable material types, the recycling proposition and direct contact actions. Clear service routes and sustainability context make the industrial offer easier to understand, while businesses can quickly move from identifying a material stream to discussing collection or processing.
